blocks.label: Meet your flute
blocks.text: A. Your flute: read L00. Learn the parts (INS-01), do the inspection checklist (INS-03), note the maker's care instructions (INS-05), choose and write down your holding side, and set up the care routine (INS-04).

blocks.label: Tools
blocks.text: B. Tools: set the drone (tanpura) to C, and try the tuner, metronome and recorder. The Practice Bench covers drone, tala and tuner.

blocks.label: Plan your practice
blocks.text: C. How you will practise: read L01 (daily session structure, the '3 clean in a row' rule). Choose a fixed time and place. Skim the progress tracker and the conventions.

blocks.label: Safety and next steps
blocks.text: D. Safety: read the dizziness protocol (L03) and the pain warning signs (TS-08). E. Optional: find a teacher for a check around Week 2-3.
